name: Holographic Particles
description: Holographic 3D particle sculptor agent: generates complex shapes with luminescent point clouds, 360° rotation and zoom controls, and academic explanations for each point.
capabilities: Full interactive controls: 360° rotation, tilt, and zoom
Clickable inspection points with holographic university professor mode
Hierarchical O(1) automated taxonomy in the 3D catalog
Autonomous nocturnal synthesis of shapes discussed during the day
WebXR headset support for volumetric stereoscopic immersion

body.label: Body
body.detail: The trunk: holds the vital organs and supports every other part.

neck.label: Neck
neck.detail: Joins the head to the trunk and allows its movement.

head.label: Head
head.detail: Holds the brain, eyes and sense organs.

snout.label: Snout
snout.detail: Nose and mouth: used to smell, eat and breathe.

beak.label: Beak
beak.detail: A tool to grab food and preen the feathers.

ears.label: Ears
ears.detail: Pick up sounds and help with balance.

horns.label: Horns
horns.detail: Rigid structures used for defence and display.

front_legs.label: Front legs
front_legs.detail: Carry the weight at the front and guide movement.

hind_legs.label: Hind legs
hind_legs.detail: Give the push to run and jump.

legs.label: Legs
legs.detail: Support the body and allow it to move.

tail.label: Tail
tail.detail: Helps with balance and shows mood.

wings.label: Wings
wings.detail: Surfaces that create the lift needed to fly.

thorax.label: Thorax
thorax.detail: Carries the legs and wings and holds the flight muscles.
